name: What steps are involved in professional log home refinishing?

mainEntity.name: What steps are involved in professional log home refinishing?

acceptedAnswer.text: The refinishing process begins with cleaning the logs using appropriate cleaners or media blasting to clear dirt, mildew, and failing coatings. After washing, the wood must dry thoroughly to an acceptable moisture level before any finish is applied. The crew then inspects and repairs damaged chinking, fills upward-facing checks, and applies high-performance exterior stain and topcoats. As a hands-on general contractor, Abraham Becerra coordinates the finish work and masking carefully so surrounding trim, glass, and exterior fixtures remain clean and fully protected throughout the project.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process includes surface cleaning or stripping, moisture drying, repairing chinking and checks, and applying protective stain and clear coats.
